pages.title: Ludo Quick: Dice Board Games
pages.creator: Nexifie L.L.C
pages.description: Roll the dice and race your tokens home in Ludo Quick: Dice Board Games. Choose which token to move based on the roll and how close your opponents are. A move that advances one piece can leave another exposed, so look at the whole board. Try to get your tokens home first.

pages.title: Bloom Tile Match
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Clear flower tiles in Bloom Tile Match. Look for matching blooms and remove them from the garden layout. Check what the board looks like after each match so you can spot the next group. Finish clearing the tiles to open a new level.

pages.title: Arrow Cube Escape
pages.creator: GTS games
pages.description: Remove arrows from all six faces of a cube in Arrow Cube Escape. Look at the direction each arrow points and check what stands in its way before trying to move it. Freeing one arrow can open a path for another. Work out an order that clears the entire cube.

pages.title: TRIVIA NATION
pages.creator: BUSIDOL
pages.description: Answer questions about sports, movies, history, science, and more in TRIVIA NATION. Work through quick rounds on your own or compare answers with friends and family. More than 400 questions give you plenty of topics to try. Choose a category and see what you can recall under pressure.

pages.title: Merge Home Mania
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Make furniture and decorate rooms in Merge Home Mania. Combine materials such as wood, stone, and textiles to create objects, and use flowers and plants to finish the spaces. Choose what to build next based on the pieces you have. Put the results together to give each room its own look.

pages.title: Boo-tiful Princess Match
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Match hidden card pairs to dress three princesses in Boo-tiful Princess Match. Remember the pictures you reveal and find their partners to unlock costume, makeup, and hairstyle details. Each match brings the current makeover closer to completion. Work through all three Halloween looks.

pages.title: Cooking Restaurant Kitchen
pages.creator: Rendered Ideas
pages.description: Prepare dishes from different cuisines in Cooking Restaurant Kitchen. Read orders, cook the food, and get it to the customers before time runs out. When several people are waiting, decide which dish to start next. Work through the service challenges as you build up the café.

pages.title: Tung Sahur Bots Chase Room
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: Escape a backroom full of meme creatures in Tung Sahur Bots Chase Room. Keep moving while Tung Tung Sahur, Tralalero Tralala, and other bots hunt you. Watch for traps before choosing a route around a pursuer. Look for a way out and try to reach it without being caught.

pages.title: Halloween Fruit Slice
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Slice fruit and steer clear of bombs in Halloween Fruit Slice. Watch what crosses the screen and swipe through several fruits to build a combo. The pace picks up as you go, so check the next target before cutting. Keep the score climbing without catching a bomb in the swipe.

pages.title: Schoolboy Runaway: room escape
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Help a boy get out of a locked room in Schoolboy Runaway: room escape. Search for hidden clues and work out how each one can help with a puzzle. Look again at details that seemed unimportant if you get stuck. Solve the room's challenges to find a way out.

pages.title: Cat Rescue
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Protect a cat from an approaching dragon in Cat Rescue. Check the colors of the dragon's segments and select a cannon that matches. A hit removes the corresponding section and slows the advance. Keep choosing the right cannon as the pattern changes until the threat is gone.

pages.title: Block Puzzle Tropical Story
pages.creator: Rainbow Games
pages.description: Solve block puzzles to explore islands in Block Puzzle Tropical Story. Complete layouts to earn stars and open new territories, from beaches to jungle areas. Use a booster when you need help with a difficult board. The stars you earn also unlock places to relax along the way.

pages.title: Spinning Uia Uia Cat Bricker
pages.creator: UznGames
pages.description: Keep the ball above the paddle in Spinning Uia Uia Cat Bricker. Send it back into the bricks and watch its rebound so you're ready for the next return. Clear the whole layout without dropping the ball. The cat meows and dances as you break more bricks.

pages.title: Color Race Obby
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Race across a field of disappearing tiles in Color Race Obby. Move toward the finish while watching for the next safe color. Get onto a tile of that color before the rest drop away, then keep running as the floor returns. Try to reach the finish before the other racers.

pages.title: Musketeers Gunpowder vs Steel
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Lead a mercenary force in Musketeers Gunpowder vs Steel. Give orders to musketeers, pikemen, and reiters in seventeenth-century battles. Train troops and decide where each kind of soldier can help before engaging the enemy. Use the formation and the timing of your orders to get the better of the opposing force.

pages.title: Spider-Noob obstacle course
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Swing between buildings and collect badges in Spider-Noob obstacle course. Use Noob's webs to work through the city and complete training challenges. Open new levels as you go and unlock costumes for Noob. Get used to where each swing will take you before you attempt a harder route.

pages.title: 3D FPS Target Shooting
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Aim and fire at targets in 3D FPS Target Shooting. Line up each shot and work through the ranges to earn coins. Use your earnings to unlock rifles such as the Kar98k, M24, and AWM. Try to improve your score as you practice with different weapons.

pages.title: Sportsball Merge
pages.creator: Monstera Games
pages.description: Drop sports orbs and merge matching ones in Sportsball Merge. Choose a place where the next orb can meet another of its kind. Each merge reveals a new exercise form and changes the space left for later drops. Keep combining them and see how high you can score.

pages.title: Zombie Highway Rampage
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Drive a Rhino truck through zombies in Zombie Highway Rampage. Steer around land mines, wrecks, and other road hazards, or shoot obstacles you can destroy. Look ahead before committing to a lane so you have room to avoid the next hazard. Keep the truck moving through the horde.

pages.title: Peg Solitaire
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Jump pegs over one another in Peg Solitaire. Each jump removes the peg you pass over, so plan where the moving peg will land before you make it. Try puzzles at different difficulty levels. The board is solved when you've removed every peg except one.

pages.title: Dream Room Makeover
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Clean and renovate an old house in Dream Room Makeover. Throw away rubbish, scrub surfaces with the sponge or mop, and use the hammer to fix damaged items. Once the room is ready, choose furniture and wallpaper. Work through the house and give each space a different look.

pages.title: Merge Snake Battle
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Grow a snake and merge others in Merge Snake Battle. Slide to steer through the arena and collect gold coins to extend your snake. Combine identical snakes to unlock stronger ones for later battles. Switch between building up your collection and taking your snake into the arena.

pages.title: Superstar Career Dress Up
pages.creator: ARPAPLUS
pages.description: Style dolls through three stages in Superstar Career Dress Up. Choose clothes for college, put together red-carpet outfits for their modeling careers, and pick dresses and accessories for the wedding stage. Browse more than 700 clothing items and try different looks across the 20 dolls.

pages.title: ATV Bike Games Quad Offroad
pages.creator: AA2G1
pages.description: Race quad bikes through off-road environments in ATV Bike Games Quad Offroad. Steer with WASD or the arrow keys, use Space for the handbrake, and hit left Shift for nitro when you have room. Change the camera with C to get another view of the track. Try to keep the bike steady over uneven ground.

pages.title: My Trendy Plaid Outfits
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Work plaid into outfits for Ariel, Moana, and Jasmine in My Trendy Plaid Outfits. Pick a piece with the pattern and compare the clothes and accessories you can wear with it. Try a different combination for each princess. Decide how much of the print you want in each finished look.

pages.title: DOP Stickman - Jailbreak
pages.creator: AdelikDev
pages.description: Draw a missing piece to help a prisoner escape in DOP Stickman - Jailbreak. Study the scene and think about what would complete it before sketching. A solved drawing takes the stickman one step closer to his beloved. Use the hint if you can't work out what's missing.

pages.title: Ball Throw Fight
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Build up a large ball and use it against monsters in Ball Throw Fight. Slide to move and accumulate material, then roll through enemies or shoot the ball to knock them back. Use skills to improve your attacks when a fight gets harder. Try different skins as you progress.

pages.title: Mia Beach Spa
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Give Mia a beachside spa session in Mia Beach Spa. Use the mouse to work through the back treatment and facial care before moving on to the makeover. Follow the order of the activities so each treatment is finished. Help Mia take a break from her usual duties.

pages.title: Battalion Commander 2
pages.creator: IriySoft
pages.description: Guide a squad into the North in Battalion Commander 2. Steer with the mouse or touch, free captured soldiers to add them to your ranks, and collect gold and experience along the way. Complete missions to unlock perks and buy upgrades. Activate skills when your squad needs extra help.

pages.title: Super Jumper
pages.creator: XTStudio
pages.description: Climb from platform to platform in Super Jumper. Tap to guide the jumper left or right and line up each landing as the next platform comes into view. The higher you climb, the better your score. Pick a side early enough to keep the next jump within reach.

pages.title: Sky Bridge
pages.creator: Gameloft SE
pages.description: Stretch a bridge to cross between rooftops in Sky Bridge. Judge the gap and stop extending the bridge when it can reach the next building. Pick up treasures on your route to summon followers. Unlock different characters and see what squads and treasures come with them.

pages.title: Rope Dude
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Cut ropes to send a mannequin into hazards in Rope Dude. Look at how the figure is suspended and decide which rope to cut first. Lasers, arrows, and spinning discs give you different ways to complete the puzzle. Set up the drop or swing that brings the mannequin into contact with a hazard.

pages.title: Physics Box
pages.creator: Gamebol
pages.description: Guide a box to the flag in Physics Box. Use jumps and the walls to change where the box goes, and think about where it will land before launching it. Each level gives you another platform layout to work through. Reach the flag to finish the route.

pages.title: ZUMAR DELUXE
pages.creator: gamesmunch.com
pages.description: Shoot colored marbles into a moving chain in ZUMAR DELUXE. Aim for groups of the same color so you can remove marbles before they get too far along the path. Watch the next stretch of the chain before firing again. Clear the challenge stages and try to earn three stars on each.

pages.title: Dino Memory
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Turn over cards and match dinosaur pictures in Dino Memory. Remember the position of an image when you reveal it so you can find its partner later. Remove every pair to finish the board. Work through 15 levels and keep track of more pictures as the layouts change.

pages.title: Spider Solitaire Blue
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Build descending runs in Spider Solitaire Blue. Move cards between columns and try to assemble complete runs of the same suit so they can be removed. Choose one suit for a simpler layout or play with two or four suits for a harder game. Keep space available before dealing more cards.

pages.title: Fly Squirrel Fly 2
pages.creator: Flash From The Past
pages.description: Launch a squirrel for distance in Fly Squirrel Fly 2. Earn cash from your attempts and take it to the shop for upgrades. Improve the launcher, add special effects, or work on the parachute so the squirrel can coast farther. Try another launch to see how the new equipment changes the flight.

pages.title: 2 Player Red Blue Pirates
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Help two pirates collect six bombs and reach the door in 2 Player Red Blue Pirates. Watch for enemies while guiding the red and blue characters through the course. Make sure both pirates get through safely. Gather every bomb needed before trying to finish at the exit.

pages.title: Icy Purple Head 3
pages.creator: Miniduck
pages.description: Deliver parcels by sliding through levels in Icy Purple Head 3. Run, jump, and use the icy slide to get through the route in time. Watch the postal birds and match the right color when you hit them. Unlock hats to give Icy another look as you work through the deliveries.

pages.title: Parkour Block Xmas Special
pages.creator: Poly Games
pages.description: Make your way through a holiday parkour course in Parkour Block Xmas Special. Look ahead at each block before you jump and judge the distance to the next landing. Work through the seasonal challenge one jump at a time. Keep your footing to reach the end of the route.

pages.title: Operation Desert Road
pages.creator: Xform
pages.description: Fight through enemy vehicles in Operation Desert Road. Move with WASD, the arrow keys, or a swipe, then fire at the enemies in your path. Use your vehicle's special attack when it can help clear the road. Try different vehicles and see how their strengths change the way you fight.

pages.title: The Princess Sent to Future
pages.creator: Top Girl Games
pages.description: Help a princess fit in after a trip through time in The Princess Sent to Future. She arrives at a modern college in her royal clothes, so start the makeover by washing and combing her hair. Choose a haircut and style her for the new setting. Use the mouse to work through the makeover.

pages.title: Halloween Pocket Sniper 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Help townspeople escape a zombie outbreak in Halloween Pocket Sniper 3D. Choose a weapon and pick off the zombies threatening the people in each scene. Watch for tougher enemies as you go. Take time to aim when a zombie is close to someone you're trying to save.

pages.title: Halloween Craft
pages.creator: MathNook
pages.description: Merge Halloween items to finish a recipe in Halloween Craft. Click an empty space to place the piece shown in the Next box. Put three or more identical items beside one another to create an upgraded item. Check the recipe at the top and keep merging before the board fills up.

pages.title: CraftTower
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Climb a castle full of green monsters in CraftTower. Use the arrow keys or touch controls to get from one step to the next. Watch what is above you before committing to a move. Keep the climber clear of the monsters until you reach the top.

pages.title: Mahjong Crush Saga
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Find matching tiles before the timer expires in Mahjong Crush Saga. Tap two tiles of the same design to remove them and look at what's available afterward. Keep working through the layout as the clock counts down. Clear the entire board to finish the level.

pages.title: DUCK DASH
pages.creator: Fat Boy Studio
pages.description: Guide a duck along a narrow route in DUCK DASH. Press Space or click to jump or change direction when the path calls for it. Watch the next bend before you reach it so the duck stays on the course. Make it to the checkpoints and discover more characters.

pages.title: Find The Differences
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Compare two pictures against the clock in Find The Differences. Click each detail that has changed and use a hint when you can't spot one. Later puzzles give you more differences to find. Move between different parts of the scene if one section is taking too long.

pages.title: Yummy Waffle Ice Cream
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Make waffles and decorate them in Yummy Waffle Ice Cream. Use the mouse to work through the cooking steps, then choose ice cream, fruit, and syrup for the topping. Try combinations that give the dessert a different look. Finish with the toppings you want to serve.

pages.title: Tug The Table Classic
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Pull a table past the line in Tug The Table Classic. Time your tugs to draw your opponent across while keeping yourself on your side. Use Up for the first player and W for the second, or use touch controls. The player who pulls the other past the line wins.

pages.title: Yummy Hotdog
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Make a hot dog from scratch in Yummy Hotdog. Gather ingredients, mix the batter, and work through the preparation with the mouse. Add sauces and toppings to finish your creation. Try to unlock the game's achievements as you work through the recipe.

pages.title: My Sweet Adventure
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Help an alien find the exit from candy land in My Sweet Adventure. Jump between platforms and collect coins while staying away from bats, monsters, and spikes. Choose a route that gets you to the exit with as many coins as you can reach. The later levels make the jumps and hazards harder.

pages.title: Hop Ball
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Keep a ball bouncing along a colored road in Hop Ball. Swipe or move the mouse to guide it onto the next tile. Look ahead before each landing, since the route can shift from one tile to the next. See how far you can go without missing the road.

pages.title: Emma Disaster
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Help Emma after a traffic accident in Emma Disaster. Take her to the hospital and follow the game's treatment steps with the mouse. Once she's recovered, help her return to her usual look. The story moves from the accident to her care and then to the makeover.

pages.title: Baby Taylor Goes Sick
pages.creator: babygames.com
pages.description: Look after Taylor when she develops a fever in Baby Taylor Goes Sick. Click or tap through the visit as her mother calls a doctor and gets instructions for her care. Help with the activities while Taylor rests. Stay with her as the story follows her recovery.

pages.title: Draw The Rest
pages.creator: vetx
pages.description: Sketch the missing part of a picture in Draw The Rest. Look at the lines already on the screen and decide what the figure needs. Tap to start drawing and fill in the missing detail. Solve each illustration to see what the next one is missing.

pages.title: Forest Brothers
pages.creator: ISS Game Studio
pages.description: Guide two squirrels to the magic nut in Forest Brothers. Control the pair with WASD and the arrow keys, or use touch, and get them there before time expires. Pick up coins while you have time, since they count toward the score if you finish. A failed attempt earns zero.

pages.title: Hill Climb Moto
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Ride a motorcycle over 2D hills in Hill Climb Moto. Use the arrow keys or touch controls to move and collect coins as you cross the route. Watch the slope before you accelerate so you can handle the next climb or descent. Keep riding and gather coins where you can.

pages.title: Sniper Bottle Shooting Game
pages.creator: mastergame
pages.description: Choose a gun and aim at bottles in Sniper Bottle Shooting Game. Use the mouse to control your weapon and judge the shot before firing. Some bottles can move, so pay attention to the target's position as you line up. Try weapons from the store as you work on your aim.

pages.title: Modern Car Parking Game 3D
pages.creator: RealGame Studio
pages.description: Practice driving and parking in Modern Car Parking Game 3D. Guide the car to its space and pay attention to how much room you have to turn. Line up the approach before steering into the spot. The challenge is putting the car in place cleanly within the 3D course.

pages.title: Street Racing Car Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Reassemble pictures of street racing cars in Street Racing Car Slide. Pick from three images and three puzzle modes, then slide the sections into place. Look for lines in the cars or background that continue across two pieces. Keep moving the sections until the picture is complete.

pages.title: Crash Car Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Put the shuffled pieces back together in Crash Car Jigsaw. Choose a picture of a crashed car and look at the damage, bodywork, and background to see which parts match. Work on the sections you recognize first. Fit the remaining pieces to reveal the whole scene.

pages.title: Super Word Search
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Find hidden words in Super Word Search. Scan the letters for the word you're looking for and follow the sequence to its end. Choose Easy, Medium, or Hard and try another setting when you want a different challenge. Keep searching until you've found the words on the board.

pages.title: Scary Granny : Horror Granny Games
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: Find keys and escape a haunted house in Scary Granny : Horror Granny Games. Search the rooms while staying alert to dangers nearby. Move carefully, since a small action can draw attention. Collect the keys needed to complete the level and get farther out of the house.

pages.title: City Mall Car Parking Simulator
pages.creator: chipchop
pages.description: Park a sports car before time runs out in City Mall Car Parking Simulator. Drive to the designated spot and think about the space the car needs before turning in. Get lined up without wasting time on the approach. Complete one parking challenge to move to another layout.

pages.title: Hoverboard Stunts Hill climb
pages.creator: Bubito
pages.description: Balance a hoverboard on mountain roads in Hoverboard Stunts Hill climb. Guide it around obstacles and watch the edges where the route passes over water. Adjust your direction before you reach a narrow stretch or sharp turn. Make it through the elevated roads without plunging off the course.

pages.title: Simulated Truck Driving
pages.creator: JZJO.COM
pages.description: Take the wheel of a truck in Simulated Truck Driving and get used to steering a larger vehicle. Use WASD to drive and press R to engage reverse. Give yourself room to turn, then use reverse to reposition the truck when the approach gets tight.

pages.title: Bubbles Vs Blocks
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Chain numbered bubbles to match a block's value in Bubbles Vs Blocks. Add the bubble values as you draw the link and use an exact total to destroy the block. Check which totals you can make before all the spaces fill. The game ends when blocks occupy all four positions.

pages.title: Zombie Infection
pages.creator: Arcade Lemon
pages.description: Summon zombies around a city in Zombie Infection. Look for groups of people and decide where to start the outbreak. Infected people help it spread, so pick a spot where the zombies can reach others. Try to infect the remaining citizens as the outbreak moves through the city.

pages.title: Tractor Delivery
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Haul cargo from the warehouse to the factory in Tractor Delivery. Keep the load aboard over uneven ground, since the amount that reaches the factory determines how many coins you earn. Spend those coins on tractor and trailer upgrades in the garage. Use WASD or the arrow keys to drive.

pages.title: Uphill Truck
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Drive a mining truck along narrow mountain roads in Uphill Truck. Steer carefully as you climb steep sections and follow the route to complete each transport mission. Slow down before a tight bend so you have room to line up the truck. Use WASD or the arrow keys to drive.

pages.title: Archery: Bow & Arrow
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Make a limited supply of arrows last in Archery: Bow & Arrow. Drag to line up your shot and release to send the arrow toward the target. A hit in the center gives you an extra arrow, so steady aim can extend the round and give you another shot at the bullseye.

pages.title: Baby Care
pages.creator: babygames.com
pages.description: Follow the baby's cues in Baby Care. Check the onscreen hints to see whether it's time for food, a bath, play, or sleep. Click or tap the item you need and work through each task as the baby's needs change over the course of the game.

pages.title: FBI Car Parking
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Take a police car through driving and parking missions in FBI Car Parking. Use the arrow keys to steer through the course and ease into the assigned space. Some missions add pursuit or stunt driving, so watch the route and adjust your speed before tight turns.

pages.title: Find Cat
pages.creator: ConchGame
pages.description: Look for a blue British shorthair who's hiding somewhere in the house in Find Cat. Search spots like the sofa and boxes, pick up items, and see how you can use what you find to reach another hiding place. Each scene gives you a new place to look.

pages.title: Glam Girls Dress Up
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Put together looks for a celebrity model in Glam Girls Dress Up. Use the mouse to browse the wardrobe and see how different clothes and accessories look together. Try a few combinations before settling on a style you would send down a runway or put on a magazine cover.

pages.title: Arithmetic Line
pages.creator: GameNing
pages.description: Guide a line toward the right answer in Arithmetic Line. Read the equation at the top of the screen and figure out which operation completes it. Click to steer the line through the matching symbol while avoiding incorrect choices. Work out the next answer before the line reaches it.

pages.title: Master Umbrella Down
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Guide the Umbrella Man down the inside of a clock tower in Master Umbrella Down. Use the umbrella to slow his fall as he passes the clockwork. Let him drop when the way opens, then slow down again to get past the next obstacle on the way to the bottom.

pages.title: Arkadium's Mahjongg Candy
pages.creator: Arkadium
pages.description: Look for pairs of identical sweets in Arkadium's Mahjongg Candy. A tile is available when it has no tile above it and at least one open side. Look at the tiles underneath before choosing which pair to remove. Clearing one pair can open up another part of the board.

pages.title: Crystal Cave Match 3
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Swap neighboring gems in Crystal Cave Match 3 to line up at least three of the same color. Each match adds to your score, and the meter on the left keeps the pressure on. Look for a new match as soon as the board settles to keep the round going.

pages.title: Tank Stars
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Aim across the battlefield in Tank Stars and land shots on the opposing tank. Use your mouse or the touchscreen to line up each attack. Watch where the shell falls and use that information when aiming again. Destroy the other tank before its fire takes yours out.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Friendship Day
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Spend Friendship Day with Baby Hazel, Kenny, and their friends. Take the group to the funfair for rides and snacks, and click on the people and objects they ask for along the way. Keep an eye on each child's requests so everyone gets a turn and the celebration keeps moving.

pages.title: My Fish Tank: Aquarium Game
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Look after pet fish and their home in My Fish Tank: Aquarium Game. Use the mouse to work through the aquarium tasks, from caring for the fish to cleaning their tank. Pay attention to what each step calls for as you put the aquarium together and get it ready for its residents.

pages.title: Connect Merge
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Draw a path through adjacent tiles with the same value in Connect Merge. Link the numbers with your mouse or finger to combine them into a higher value. Look at the surrounding tiles before committing to a chain so you can set up another merge when the new number appears.

pages.title: Flower saga
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Start a chain of blooms in Flower saga. Click a flower to send petals flying toward the others, which can blossom in turn if the petals reach them. Look at how the flowers line up and decide where to start the reaction before the available sunlight runs out.

pages.title: Room Spot Differences
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Compare two pictures of the same room in Room Spot Differences. Scan the furniture, decorations, and background for anything that's changed, then click where you see the difference. Use the hint button if you get stuck and try to find every change before the timer runs out.

pages.title: Princess Matches Your Personality
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Make color choices in Princess Matches Your Personality to see what they say about your style. Use the mouse to select the shades you prefer and work through the quiz. At the end, see how your answers match up with the personality of the princess.

pages.title: Snake Puzzle Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Piece together pictures of snakes in Snake Puzzle Challenge. Pick an image and choose an easy, medium, or hard layout. Drag the pieces into place with your mouse or touchscreen and use the colors and edges as clues. You can take your time with each picture.

pages.title: Super Doll Ear Doctor
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Help Super Doll treat an ear infection after a flight in Super Doll Ear Doctor. Tap through the treatment and use the available instruments to clean out her ear. Switch tools as needed to remove liquid and bacteria, including a laser for the bugs that remain.

pages.title: Boom Dot
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Launch your dot across the screen in Boom Dot and try to hit a moving target. Tap or click when the target crosses your line of fire. Watch its speed and direction before committing to a shot. Every hit keeps the run going and gives you another target to line up.

pages.title: Fly Car Stunt
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Drive across suspended shipping containers in Fly Car Stunt. Keep your wheels on the narrow course and line up the next landing before you cross a gap. Go for the finish on your own or race a friend on the same keyboard using WASD and the arrow keys.

pages.title: Princess Photo Shopping Dressup
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Get Emma, Mia, and Bella ready for a photo shoot in Princess Photo Shopping Dressup. Shop for clothes, then use the mouse to try on pieces and build an outfit for each girl. See how the outfits look together when all three step in front of the camera.

pages.title: 2048 Solitaire
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Build a 2048 card in 2048 Solitaire. Drag number cards from the bottom of the screen into columns where equal values can merge. A placement that triggers multiple merges earns a higher multiplier for that move. Leave room for incoming cards while you build toward the target number.

pages.title: Bingo King
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Watch the called numbers and mark your card in Bingo King. Compare your marks with the pattern for the round so you can spot when you're close to bingo. Try to complete the pattern first and earn coins and experience as you unlock additional levels.

pages.title: Burger Chef Restaurant
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Take customer orders and run a burger counter in Burger Chef Restaurant. Use your mouse to assemble each burger with the requested ingredients and serve it to the right customer. Work through restaurant levels or see how many orders you can handle under pressure in Time Attack.

pages.title: Match Me More
pages.creator: The Ardents
pages.description: Look beyond color to clear the board in Match Me More. Depending on the stage, pieces can match by shape, number, color, or a combination of features. Check which attributes count before moving a piece and try to clear the required matches in as few moves as you can.

pages.title: Mr Pong
pages.creator: T
pages.description: Keep Mr. Pong bouncing between the side walls in Mr Pong. Click or tap to jump and aim for the moving paddles, which give you a safe place to bounce back. Watch how high the opposite paddle is moving and time your jump to avoid the spikes along the walls.

pages.title: Bonnie in Riverdale
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Help Bonnie get ready for her first day as an exchange student in Bonnie in Riverdale. Browse the wardrobe and put together a look for Riverdale High. Try different clothes, shoes, and hairstyles to see how each combination fits the occasion before sending her to school.

pages.title: Transmorpher 3
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Switch between aliens to solve platform puzzles in Transmorpher 3. One form can stick to surfaces, while another can push heavy objects out of the way. Look at what blocks the exit before deciding which ability to use. On a keyboard, press 1, 2, or 3 to change forms.

pages.title: Dont Mess Up
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Read each command and react before time runs out in Dont Mess Up. Tap when the screen asks for a tap and swipe when it calls for a swipe. Follow the current prompt closely, especially when it changes from the last one. A wrong move brings the run to an end.

pages.title: Dream Shoes Designer
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Create a pair of shoes for a fashion event in Dream Shoes Designer. Choose a design, test colors and patterns, and look at how they work together before you enter your finished pair. A jury votes on the result, so you can see how your design fares.

pages.title: Stick Panda
pages.creator: Freelance
pages.description: Build a bridge between platforms in Stick Panda. Hold down to extend a stick, then release to drop it across the gap and let the panda walk over. Judge the distance each time so the end of the stick lands on the next platform instead of leaving the panda without a crossing.

pages.title: Super Robo Fighter
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Assemble your own robot and send it into battle in Super Robo Fighter. Click or tap to work through the build, then face other robots in the arena. Try to earn KizKoins and see how high a score you can reach in the time it takes to finish.

pages.title: Pen Pineapple Five Nights at Freddy's
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Throw pens at moving fruit and monsters in Pen Pineapple Five Nights at Freddy's. Click or tap when a target lines up with the throw. Two shots in a row through the center trigger a bonus, so wait for the opening and aim for a clean hit.

pages.title: Catch 'em All
pages.creator: Stupid in a Box
pages.description: Tap the requested blob in Catch 'em All before the timer runs out. Look across the board for a blob that matches the current target. A tap also catches matching blobs in its row and column, so check both directions to find the tile that clears the biggest group.

pages.title: Pilar Sky
pages.creator: Ventus Games
pages.description: Stack blocks as high as you can in Pilar Sky. Use the up arrow to build and the down arrow to remove a block. Watch the colors as you go, since putting matching colors together stops the climb. Clear the top block when it would clash with the next one.

pages.title: Icesters Trouble
pages.creator: Next Realm Games
pages.description: Get the ice cubes onto the icy platform in Icesters Trouble. Remove pieces of the structure and watch how the ice shifts as gravity takes over. Plan the order so the cubes settle on the platform instead of sliding off. Each arrangement gives you a different balance to work out.

pages.title: Beautys Fall Fashion Collection
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Try on fall outfits with Belle in Beautys Fall Fashion Collection. Mix denim with patched jackets or layer a crochet coat over a floral dress or romper. Try a few combinations to see how the pieces look together and pick a look from Belle's new wardrobe.

pages.title: Dolly Princess vs. Villain Dress Up
pages.creator: GlossyPlay
pages.description: Dress Dove and Tris for opposite sides of a fashion battle in Dolly Princess vs. Villain Dress Up. Open boxes to reveal outfits, hairstyles, and accessories, then decide what works for each doll's role. Browse the gallery to revisit the looks and check the achievements as you play.

pages.title: Hollywood Trivia
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Recognize Hollywood stars from photos in Hollywood Trivia. Each round shows a face and several possible names. Choose the name you think fits before the timer runs down. Keep answering to see where your score puts you on the quiz's movie fan scale.

pages.title: Zoo Panic
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Choose a zoo animal and fly it through an obstacle course in Zoo Panic. Use the mouse to control its flight, grab coins along the way, and look for fuel pickups to keep the jetpack going. Try to travel farther on the next run while collecting more coins.

pages.title: So Sakura: Moviestar
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Prepare a movie star for the cameras in So Sakura: Moviestar. Work through the beauty and styling steps, then try different combinations as you build the finished look. Take your time with each choice and see how the makeover comes together when she's ready for her appearance.

pages.title: Spinach Rotolo: Sara’s Cooking Class
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Follow Sara's recipe in Spinach Rotolo: Sara’s Cooking Class. Find the ingredients and utensils the game asks for, then follow the prompts to prepare the spinach dish. Move through the cooking steps in order and see the finished rotolo when your work in the kitchen is done.

pages.title: Dove Magazine Dolly Dress Up
pages.creator: GlossyPlay
pages.description: Style Dove for the cover of a fashion magazine in Dove Magazine Dolly Dress Up. Open boxes to discover tops, bottoms, and accessories, then see what works together for the cover shoot. Try new combinations and check the achievements as you decide which outfit to keep.

pages.title: Elsa New Year Makeup
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Get Elsa ready for a New Year's party in Elsa New Year Makeup. Start with a spa treatment, then tap to pick contouring, eyeshadow, and mascara. Finish the makeover with a face-paint design that works with the makeup you chose for the celebration.

pages.title: Mommy Home Decoration
pages.creator: DariaGames.com
pages.description: Furnish a bedroom and nursery in Mommy Home Decoration. Try different wall colors, floors, furniture, and decorations to see what suits each room. Start with the mother's bedroom, then pick a crib and finish arranging the baby's room in a style of your choice.
